text:
sophia: quick heads-up — AcmeX announced an embeddings tier that matches our pricing on short contexts. we should discuss whether we do a targeted parity or double-down on a differentiator.

mike: thanks. do we have customer asks pushing parity?

jamie-sales: yes, 2 mid-market pilots flagged price parity as the make/break. they want cheaper short-embedding use for search.

anna: but we also have 3 strategic customers asking for stronger per-route SLOs and routing controls (dedicated + private). that's a differentiation angle.

ben: tradeoff summary from eng: parity on embeddings pricing for short contexts is ~2 sprint effort (batching + cheaper quantized variant), but per-route SLO control touches infra + console -> ~6 sprints.

lara: what if we scope a minimal parity slab: ship a "lite embeddings" SKU (quantized small model, limited context) and schedule per-route SLO as next quarter?

anna: need launch criteria for the lite SKU: 95th p90 latency <= 40ms for 128-token queries, cost/unit <= 0.6x current base. otherwise we won't advertise price parity.

mike: agree. also add a quality gate: retrieval relevance drop <= 5% on our benchmark set. we can't undermine core value.

ben: noted. engineering spike to validate quantized variant for 128-token batch perf — i'll open a spike PR today.

sophia: product ask: include a canary config so we can route pilot customers to lite SKU for 2 weeks and collect delta metrics: latency, cost, and NPS from pilots.

deploy-bot: canary created: env=staging-lite-sku, policy=percentage(2%), duration=14d.

jamie-sales: pls tag the 2 pilots: @AcmeRetail and @BetaDocs. they'll be first to try it.

lara: for messaging — we'll position lite SKU as "cost-optimized short-embedding tier" not "low-quality". docs must show constraints (context limit, no advanced reranking).

anna: we need an experiment plan: metrics to measure and thresholds for rollback. i'll draft: latency p95, embedding cost/unit, retrieval MRR, pilot satisfaction. also add a binary rollback condition if relevance drop > 7%.

mike: timeline check: spike end by EOW, alpha by mid-next-sprint, canary with pilots by next-next-sprint. does that fit?

ben: doable if we re-prioritize some infra work — i'll coordinate with eng-sre.

sophia: decision: ship lite SKU as a scoped parity move with explicit limits, while preserving roadmap commit to per-route SLOs in Q3. document the commitment publicly in the roadmap notes so enterprise customers see the path.

jamie-sales: perfect. i'll update pilot kickoff and pricing terms.

lara: i'll own docs + marketing blurb. anna please own experiment plan and rollback thresholds.

anna: on it. will post the plan and a short test harness for the pilots by tomorrow.

mike: tiny follow-up: are we adding a feature flag to hide lite SKU from self-serve? we may want to gate until pilots finish.

ben: yes, feature flag exists. default off for self-serve; can be toggled per-tenant.

sophia: thanks team. i'll add this as a scoped roadmap update and include the Q3 per-route SLO milestone. closing this thread — followups in the PRs. :raised_hands:
